subject: Newsletter topic activity for the Co-op
body:
Bombora's Co-op is described as thousands of media destinations including publishers, B2B brands and premium data providers, and topic-level research behaviour is modelled from that. Newsletters are publishers whose behaviour may already reach you through their web archives, or may not reach you at all, and I would rather ask than guess.

NewsletterFIT holds more than 27,000 publications and 143,000 articles, with companies, people, topics, guests and 2,200 sponsors extracted, plus repeated snapshots of publication activity. If a newsletter source adds topic coverage your web signals miss, a licensing conversation is the right shape. If it does not, that answer is worth having.
